comment: Reviewed npm advisories that do not reach the shipped app. Each entry: the advisory, the package, where it is used, and why the app is not affected. scripts/check-audit.js fails on any advisory not listed here and reports entries that are no longer needed. Remove an entry as soon as a fixed version can be installed. Same review as MuxCloud.Mobile.

advisories.reason: Denial of service via globparts amplification. Build and test tooling only (Jest, @expo/fingerprint, glob) matching this project's own patterns, never user input; not in the app bundle. The fixed major is not accepted by the dependent tools' version ranges.

AbortSignal cancellation bypass. Build and test tooling only (Jest core and coverage) walking this project's own folders; the app never passes an AbortSignal to glob and glob is not in the app bundle.
